item_reviews.summary: Medical deck contact sheet is blocked below the mature doctoral group-meeting paper-talk bar.
observations: Slides 4 and 5 contain visible lower-page crowding.
Slide 6 has an overloaded comparison construction.
The deck has credible real-paper visual evidence but remains below the mature presentation bar.

blocking_findings.summary: The architecture evidence page contains overlapping, unreadable footer content.
blocking_findings.evidence: Medical slide 4 has visibly overprinted lower text: the figure/citation line and the explanatory sentence overlap across the bottom margin.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Separate the figure citation from the explanatory takeaway and provide adequate bottom margin.

blocking_findings.summary: The limitations slide is not presentation-ready.
blocking_findings.evidence: Medical slide 5 has substantive collisions: the comparator-arm labels overlap, the decision-rule paragraph begins into the diamond region, and the bottom conclusion collides with the final lines of that paragraph.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Reflow the diagram and conclusion into non-overlapping regions; simplify comparator labels or split the content.

blocking_findings.summary: The medical comparison evidence is partially obstructed by its own annotations.
blocking_findings.evidence: Medical slide 6 places the "Overlay legend" directly over the lower MedSAM crop; legend text and colored markers obscure the image, while connector lines cross the crop/legend area.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Move the legend outside all image panels and reroute/remove connector lines so each same-case crop remains unobscured.
